title: Police budget: reduce requested increase to 7%
summary: Council considered limiting the Police Service budget increase to 7%.
motion_text: That the Police Service budget be reduced to 7 per cent (page 257).
notes: The motion states the target percentage but not the exact dollar reduction; no dollar amount is inferred.

title: Police budget returned for potential reductions
summary: Council directed the Police Services Board to consider potential reductions to its 2026 budget.
motion_text: That the Police Service budget be returned to the Police Service Board for potential reductions.
notes: Direction to reconsider; the motion itself did not set a dollar reduction.

title: Use $3M of Legacy income reserve to reduce the levy
summary: Council directed staff to use an additional $3 million from the Legacy reserve to reduce the 2026 net tax levy.
motion_text: That Council direct staff to move $3,000,000 from the Legacy Fund Reserve (page 275) to reduce the net tax levy.
notes: This is the additional one-time 2026 levy offset, distinct from the regular use of Legacy investment income for capital.

title: Restore $32K of Library collections through the tax levy
summary: A motion to restore $32,000 of Library collections funding in the 2026 operating budget from the net tax levy was defeated.
motion_text: That the 2026 Draft Operating Budget be amended to restore funding for the Library Collections line by providing $32,000 dollars in 2026 (from the net tax levy), with the remaining amount of the reduction to be fully restored in the 2027 budget.

title: Restore $32K of Library collections from reserve
summary: Council unanimously supported restoring $32,000 of Library collections funding from the Library Materials Acquisition Reserve.
motion_text: That the 2026 Capital Budget be amended to restore funding for the Library Collections line by providing $32,000 dollars in 2026 (from the Library Materials Acquisition Reserve pg. 231), with the remaining amount of the reduction to be fully restored in the 2027 budget.

title: Cap contingency budget at $1M
summary: Council considered capping the contingency budget at $1 million.
motion_text: That the Contingency Budget be capped at $1,000,000 (pg 254).
notes: The cap is explicit, but the source excerpt does not establish the exact delta from the draft amount; no savings amount is inferred.

summary: Funding to expand Trinity daytime operating hours failed on a 5–5 tie.
motion_text: Trinity daytime hours: $244,800
notes: Committee-stage vote. Subsequent Council consideration can be shown separately where the final disposition differs.

title: Trinity overnight program: $264,000
summary: Council supported $264,000 from the Social Services Reserve to extend the overnight drop-in program through summer 2025.
motion_text: $264,000 for the Trinity Community Centre Overnight Drop-In Program to extend operations for six months the following summer.

title: Housing Stability Fund: +$360,000
summary: Council unanimously supported a $360,000 increase to the Housing Stability Fund from the Social Services Reserve.
motion_text: $360,000 increase to the Housing Stability Fund to support prevention and diversion.

title: Brock Mission additional worker: $280,000
summary: Council unanimously supported $280,000 from the Social Services Reserve to maintain Brock Mission capacity at 40 beds.
motion_text: $280,000 to Brock Mission for an additional worker to keep bed capacity at 40 beds.

title: Trinity daytime drop-in hours: $240,000
summary: Council supported $240,000 from the Social Services Reserve to extend daytime drop-in operating hours in 2025.
motion_text: $240,000 from the Social Services Reserve to extend operating hours at the Trinity daytime drop-in program for 2025.

title: Shift about $3M of 2024 tax burden to commercial/industrial classes
summary: Finance Committee supported increasing the commercial and industrial tax ratios from 1.5 to 1.65 to shift approximately $3 million of the 2024 net tax requirement away from the residential class.
motion_text: That the 2024 tax ratios for the commercial and industrial subclasses be increased from 1.5% of the residential rate to 1.65%, to shift approximately $3,000,000 of the net tax requirement burden in 2024 from the residential tax class to the Commercial and Industrial tax classes.
notes: This changes how the levy is distributed among tax classes; it does not reduce the City-wide tax requirement.

title: Use $800K of Legacy income reserve to reduce the 2024 tax rate
summary: Finance Committee supported drawing $800,000 from the Legacy Fund Income Reserve to reduce the proposed 2024 all-inclusive tax-rate increase by 0.40 percentage points.
motion_text: That funds be drawn from the Legacy Fund Income Reserve in the amount of $800,000 to reduce the proposed all-inclusive tax rate increase by 0.40%.
notes: This was the first of two one-time Legacy-income-reserve draws incorporated into the final 2024 budget; final Council later added another $510,000.

title: Use $200K of Casino reserve to reduce the 2024 tax rate
summary: Finance Committee supported drawing $200,000 from the Casino Gaming Reserve to reduce the proposed all-inclusive tax-rate increase by 0.10 percentage points.
motion_text: That funds be drawn from the Casino Gaming Reserve in the amount of $200,000 to reduce the proposed all-inclusive tax rate increase by 0.10%.

title: Rework 2024 traffic-calming capital funding
summary: Finance Committee reduced the Traffic Calming Program by $600,000 and added $200,000 to the Transportation Safety Program from the Capital Levy Reserve.
motion_text: Reduce Capital Project 21-093 Traffic Calming Program by $600,000, from $700,000 to $100,000; and increase Capital Project 24-110 Transportation Safety Program by $200,000, funded from the Capital Levy Reserve.
notes: Two explicit amounts are involved ($600K reduction and $200K increase); the explorer does not collapse them into a single inferred fiscal impact.

title: Increase selected Service Grants by $43,800
summary: Finance Committee approved a 1.5% adjustment for selected service-grant recipients, funded with $43,800 from the 2024 General Contingency provision.
motion_text: Adjust funding of Service Grants to selected organizations to a 1.5% increase in 2024; the $43,800 increase shall be funded from the 2024 General Contingency provision.

title: Pre-approve $250K for Bonnerworth-related design
summary: Finance Committee unanimously pre-approved $250,000 in the 2025 budget for initial active-transportation and road design associated with the Bonnerworth Park redevelopment.
motion_text: That Council pre-approve $250,000 for the 2025 budget, funded from the capital levy, to support the initial design of active transportation and related road improvements to support the Bonnerworth Park redevelopment.

title: Proposed Parkhill resurfacing deferral and $125K reallocation
summary: A motion to postpone resurfacing on part of Parkhill Road and transfer $125,000 to a new capital project for short-term improvements was defeated.
motion_text: Postpone resurfacing of Parkhill Road from Medical Drive to Wallis Drive and transfer $125,000 from Capital Project #22-020 to a new capital project to initiate short-term improvement work.
notes: The motion would have reallocated existing capital funding; $125K is not treated as a new City-wide expenditure.

title: Transfer $226,021 physician-recruitment budget to reserve
summary: Council unanimously supported temporarily transferring $226,021 for physician recruitment to the Doctor Recruitment Incentive Reserve, with one member absent.
motion_text: That the amount for Physician Recruitment of $226,021 be transferred temporarily to the Doctor Recruitment Incentive Reserve; and that staff report back in Q1 2024 about hiring a physician recruiter.
notes: This moves approved funding to a reserve rather than creating a new $226,021 levy impact.

title: Defer $150K Sherbrooke Street EA to reduce 2024 levy
summary: Council deferred the $150,000 Sherbrooke Street Reconstruction Class EA amendment and used the resulting Capital Levy financing reduction to reduce the 2024 net tax levy requirement.
motion_text: That the Amendment to the Sherbrooke Street Reconstruction Class EA in the amount of $150,000 be deferred and the resulting reduction in Capital Levy financing be used to reduce the 2024 Net Tax Levy Requirement.

title: Increase 2024 transit fares to add $100K revenue
summary: Council increased several Peterborough Transit fares and budgeted an additional $100,000 in public-transit fare revenue.
motion_text: That Public Transit Fare Revenues in the 2024 Budget be increased by $100,000 and proposed Transit Rates be amended, including increasing the single ride from $2.75 to $3.00.
notes: The $100K is additional budgeted service revenue, not an expenditure.

title: Fund free transit for youth at $33,400
summary: Council approved implementing free transit for youth and high-school students by September 2025 with $33,400 from the 2025 tax levy.
motion_text: That the free transit program for youth and high school students be implemented by September 2025 and that a budget of $33,400 be assigned to this program, with the funds drawn from the Tax Levy for 2025.

title: Eliminate vacant Climate Change Coordinator position
summary: Council voted to eliminate the vacant Climate Change Coordinator position during final 2025 budget deliberations.
motion_text: That the Climate Change Coordinator position, currently vacant, be eliminated.
notes: The official motion does not state the exact dollar saving, so no amount is inferred.

title: Request 2030 extension for Ontario Heritage Act listed-property deadline
summary: General Committee supported asking Ontario to extend the statutory deadline for processing listed heritage properties from January 1, 2025 to January 1, 2030.
motion_text: That the City of Peterborough formally request the Province of Ontario to extend the deadline to process listed properties under the Ontario Heritage Act from January 1, 2025 to January 1, 2030, with the resolution circulated to relevant provincial officials.
notes: The motion concerned provincial heritage-processing timelines; no direct dollar impact was stated in the recorded motion.

title: Approve the 2024 City Asset Management Plan
summary: General Committee unanimously approved the 2024 Asset Management Plan, which documents the condition, lifecycle needs and long-term management framework for municipal infrastructure.
motion_text: That the 2024 City of Peterborough Asset Management Plan be approved.
notes: The plan has major long-term financial relevance, but this approval motion itself did not state a single incremental dollar impact.

title: Proposed deferral of Council Compensation Review
summary: A motion to defer the Council Compensation Review for additional comparator information was defeated 2–9.
motion_text: That Report FCSFS25-008 be deferred for additional comparables.
notes: This record captures the deferral motion, not the later substantive compensation recommendation.
